name: Hoshigaoka Odoru
source:
She is a so-called “YOWTUBER” who is aiming to become an idol by earning views on the video site [YOWTUBE] and selling her name. Normally, she is a simple company employee who is starting to think that she is too old to be an idol and that she will have to resort to any means necessary. After acquiring a ticket for the “Uzushio”, Odoru plans to attract the attention of the press, many of whom are on board for the maiden voyage, by making a conspicuous appearance onboard the ship.

[Translated from [url=http://www.turumiku.jp/product/uzushio/#character02]the game's website[/url]]
